scope: Proposition 4.4 (The canonical formal root) of the manuscript “Abundance in numerical dimension one for terminal threefolds in positive characteristic” (preprints/Abundance-in-numerical-dimension-one-for-terminal-threefolds-in-positive-characteristic-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 035 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5e170f2c29b7026e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 27. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every coefficient of B∗ in Equation 4.1 is divisible by pb. Writing B∗ = pbB0 with B0 integral, there is an isomorphism on the completion along D, ω̂V ≃ ÔV (B0). (4.12)
